profile.summary: Mahalaxmi Fabric Mills Limited manufactures and trades in traditional textile and technical textile products in India. The company offers finished and processed, cotton, polyester, denim, bottom-weight, and other fabrics. It also engages in fabric print and fab dyeing activities. The company exports its products.
